entities.summary: Eduardo Struvay Jaramillo is a former Colombian professional tennis player. He competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour and ITF Futures, both in singles and doubles. He reached his highest ATP singles ranking of world No. 231 on 13 February 2013, and his highest ATP doubles ranking of No. 177 on 3 February 2014.
